snippet.description:
Do you remember the beautiful days of childhood when we used to leave home just to play with our friends? ❤️🥹

Relive the golden memories of 1990s Indian childhood with this heartwarming Ghibli-inspired animation!

In this nostalgic story, Sonu leaves his home to play outside and goes to call his best friend Motu. Together, they invite Gudiya and Pihu, and all four friends head towards the village playground. Along the way, they enjoy a fun running race, laugh at Motu for being the slowest runner, and make exciting plans to play Gilli Danda, Cricket and Chhupan Chhupai.

Just like the unforgettable 90s childhood, they enjoy their day without mobile phones, video games or modern technology. As evening approaches, they return home happily, promising to meet again tomorrow for more fun and games.

❤️ Those childhood days were truly special!

What You Will Remember:

* Playing with childhood friends
* Running races in village streets
* Gilli Danda and traditional Indian games
* Cricket and Chhupan Chhupai
* Beautiful 1990s Indian village life
* Friendship, laughter and childhood memories

El vehículo avanzó entre los peatones cerca de una estación del metro en esta zona muy transitada, hasta terminar sobre la banqueta, debajo del toldo de un puesto de comida. Entre los heridos graves se encuentra quien conducía la unidad. Imágenes aéreas muestran a bomberos y policías trabajando en el lugar mientras las autoridades investigan si el atropellamiento fue accidental o intencional.

snippet.description:
Bahu Ne Saas Ko Mehngay Restaurant Mein Khane Ke Bahane Zeher De Diya | Magar Sach Kuch Aur Nikla

Zoya apni shaadi ki pehli saalgirah par apni saas Nusrat Begum ko ek mehngay restaurant mein dinner par le jaati hai, magar wahan achanak Nusrat Begum ke soup mein zeher milne se unki haalat kharab ho jaati hai. Police ko Zoya ke purse se ek khaali sheeshi milti hai aur woh apne jurm ka iqraar bhi kar leti hai. Lekin Zoya kehti hai ke us ne yeh sab apni maa Shehnaz ki maut ka badla lene ke liye kiya hai. Bees saal pehle Zoya ne apni aankhon se dekha tha ke Nusrat Begum ne uski maa ko doodh ka glass diya aur woh munh se jhaag nikalte hue mar gayi. Arsalan jab purani haveli mein Bua Jannat se milta hai to pata chalta hai ke us raat ka sach kuch aur tha. Asal mein Nusrat Begum ke shohar Iftikhar Ahmed ne apni biwi ko maarne ke liye doodh mein zeher milaya tha, lekin Nusrat ne apna glass beemar Shehnaz ko de diya tha. Iftikhar ki purani diary se yeh khaufnaak raaz saamne aata hai aur Zoya ko apni ghalti ka ehsaas hota hai. Nusrat Begum batati hain ke woh bees saal se Zoya aur uske Abba ki madad karti rahi hain aur isi liye unhone Zoya ko apni bahu banaya tha. Aakhir Zoya apna jurm chhupane ke bajaye khud sach qabool kar leti hai aur adalat ke faislay ka saamna karne ka wada karti hai. 
Nusrat Begum Shehnaz ke naam par purani haveli mehnatkash auraton ke liye kholne ka faisla karti hain. Yeh kahani sikhati hai ke inteqam aur khamoshi dono zeher hain, jabke sach aur maafi rishton ko dobara jorne ka raasta dikhate hain.

snippet.title: Mum needs help with her leg  #swanrescue #wildliferescue #animalrescue
snippet.description:
The mum of this lovely swan family was seen trapped by line around her leg, unable to move from the spot. She managed to snap the line but after she had circled multiple times which made her leg look like a cotton reel.

Located in Deeping St. James, Lincolnshire - Sarah and I went to help her. Swans that are used to people are a breeze to attract with food and so it wasn't long before she was comfortably lifted from the water. No skin was broken fortunately and the indentation will soon relax and return to normal. It's awful to think that without intervention tight constrictions can result in the loss of the limb - which is seen all too often in birds that are harder to catch such as Egyptian geese.

It's always a relief to assist and return straight away - especially when it's a parent.

snippet.title: GIBRAN TETAP FIGHT DI PTUN! Puluhan Anggota DPR Ajukan Usulan HMP, Bagaimana Nasib Wapres? | (11/11)
snippet.description:
Sejumlah pimpinan partai politik koalisi pemerintah memberikan tanggapan terkait kabar Wakil Presiden Gibran Rakabuming Raka yang telah menyampaikan niat mengundurkan diri kepada Presiden Prabowo Subianto.

Ketua Umum Partai Demokrat Agus Harimurti Yudhoyono (AHY), Ketua Umum Partai Golkar Bahlil Lahadalia, dan Ketua Umum PKB Muhaimin Iskandar menyampaikan pandangan masing-masing di Kompleks Istana Kepresidenan, Jakarta, Selasa (10/11/2026).

AHY mengaku belum mengetahui secara persis isi pembicaraan Presiden Prabowo dengan Gibran. Demokrat memilih menunggu perkembangan serta memastikan proses politik tetap berjalan sesuai konstitusi.

Nama AHY juga muncul dalam perbincangan mengenai kemungkinan calon pengganti Gibran apabila kursi Wakil Presiden nantinya kosong.

Namun, saat ditanya mengenai peluang tersebut, AHY enggan berspekulasi. Dia menyatakan belum ada sesuatu yang konklusif dan Demokrat masih berkomunikasi dengan fraksi-fraksi lain di DPR.

Sementara itu, Bahlil Lahadalia menyatakan belum mendapatkan informasi lengkap mengenai pertemuan Prabowo dan Gibran.

Bahlil menegaskan saran yang disampaikan Presiden kepada Wakil Presiden patut dihormati. Golkar juga masih menunggu perkembangan sebelum menentukan langkah berikutnya.

Ketua Umum PKB Muhaimin Iskandar atau Cak Imin menyampaikan sikap serupa. Dia menyatakan PKB masih menunggu masukan dari fraksi di DPR serta hasil konsolidasi antarfraksi.

Sebelumnya, Menteri Sekretaris Negara Prasetyo Hadi mengungkapkan bahwa Gibran telah menyampaikan niat mengundurkan diri ketika bertemu Presiden Prabowo selama sekitar 2,5 jam.

Pertemuan tersebut berkaitan dengan dinamika polemik dokumen pendidikan Gibran dan putusan pengadilan yang menjadi perhatian publik.

Meski demikian, hingga perkembangan tersebut, belum ada keputusan resmi mengenai pengunduran diri Gibran. Wakil Presiden masih menjalankan jabatannya.

snippet.title: 受け入れがたい人事配置の裏には、成長のチャンスが隠れているかもしれない。 #伊藤沙莉 #女性の生き方 #映画
snippet.description:

snippet.title: Aku Menyembunyikan Air Mata Setelah Mengetahui Penyakit yang Menghancurkan Masa Depanku 😢💔
snippet.description:
【Judul】1 Liter of Tears (2005)

【Sinopsis】Seorang remaja yang awalnya hidup normal mulai mengalami gangguan koordinasi tubuh, mulai dari kesulitan memegang sumpit, sering terjatuh, hingga kehilangan kendali atas gerakannya sendiri. Setelah menjalani pemeriksaan, ia akhirnya mengetahui bahwa dirinya mengidap ALS, penyakit saraf yang tidak dapat disembuhkan dan perlahan akan melumpuhkan seluruh tubuhnya. Meski kenyataan itu menghancurkan hati dirinya dan keluarganya, ia berusaha menyembunyikan kesedihan dan tetap menjalani hari-harinya dengan penuh semangat. Sadar bahwa waktu yang dimilikinya semakin terbatas, ia bertekad untuk terus mengejar impian dan menghargai setiap momen bersama orang-orang tercinta. Bahkan ketika lima tahun kemudian tubuhnya lumpuh total, semangat dan keteguhan hatinya justru menjadi sumber inspirasi serta harapan bagi banyak orang yang mengalami nasib serupa.

snippet.title: 하룻밤 만에 완성된 전설의 듀엣/You’re The One That I Want1978_John Travolta & Olivia Newton-John
snippet.description:
곡명: You’re The One That I Want
아티스트: John Travolta & Olivia Newton-John
발매 연도: 1978년 5월 싱글 발매 (영화 '그리스' 오리지널 사운드트랙)
작사/작곡: John Farrar
장르: 팝, 팝 록

영화를 위해 새로 쓴 곡
이 곡은 무대 뮤지컬 '그리스'에는 없던 넘버로, 영화화 과정에서 새로 추가된 곡이다. 올리비아 뉴턴 존의 출연에 맞춰 존 파라가 작곡과 프로듀싱을 맡았다. 파라가 밤을 새워 곡을 완성한 뒤 이른 아침 올리비아의 트레일러를 찾아가 들려주었고, 그 자리에서 히트를 직감했다는 이야기가 전해진다.
영화보다 먼저 터진 히트
싱글은 영화 개봉에 앞선 1978년 5월에 발매되어 극장에 걸리기 전부터 화제를 모았다. 미국 빌보드 핫 100에서 1위에 올랐고, 영국과 호주를 비롯한 여러 나라에서도 정상을 차지했다. 전 세계에서 1,500만 장 이상 팔린 것으로 추정되는 '그리스'의 대표곡이다.
변신을 알리는 사운드
반복되는 기타 리프와 탄력 있는 리듬 위에서 두 사람의 보컬이 주고받는 후렴이 곡의 중독성을 만든다. 1950년대 배경의 로큰롤 감성에 1970년대 후반의 팝 사운드를 입힌 구성이다. 청순한 이미지로 사랑받던 올리비아가 가죽 재킷 차림으로 변신하는 순간과 맞물리며, 그녀의 이미지 전환을 알린 곡으로도 평가받는다.
대중음악사적 의의
영화 속 한 장면을 넘어 하나의 팝 클래식이 된 곡이다. 레트로한 무대 위에 당대의 팝 감각을 겹쳐 세대를 가리지 않는 사랑을 받았고, 지금도 '그리스'를 떠올리면 가장 먼저 생각나는 후렴으로 남아 있다.
